title: When a dataset goes public, its Mascot release is typically ≥5.2 years old; its Skyline release ≥1.4
sub:
PRIDE datasets released 2013–2025 whose deposited files record an exact software release (one value per dataset and tool). Age = public release date
minus the first PRIDE submission recording the same release. Software exists on or before that date, so every age is a lower bound.
notes: Sensitivity: anchoring each release at the second contributor group to record it gives medians Skyline 1.2, FragPipe 1.5, DIA-NN 2.1, MaxQuant 3.3, Mascot 4.9 y. Excluded: 2 datasets whose PRIDE release date precedes the first-seen submission; 4 Skyline files whose "version" was "64-bit".
